headline: Phillies rout Diamondbacks 7-1, win sixth straight
recap: The Phillies routed the Diamondbacks 7-1 in Phoenix on Tuesday. Trea Turner doubled home Kyle Schwarber in the first inning, then scored two batters later on a Luis Arraez double-play grounder that also erased Bryce Harper at second, making it 2-0. Alec Bohm's RBI single in the fifth scored Harper for a 3-0 lead before Jordan Lawlar answered with a solo homer in the bottom half to make it 3-1. Philadelphia pulled away with a three-run eighth: Justin Crawford's RBI single scored Bryson Stott, Kyle Schwarber's sacrifice fly brought home J.T. Realmuto, and Harper's RBI single scored Crawford. Bryson Stott added a sacrifice-fly RBI in the ninth for the final run. Harper finished 4-for-4 with a walk, and Jesus Luzardo (13-5) allowed one run over 6 2/3 innings with six strikeouts to beat Eduardo Rodriguez (14-5).
The win extended Philadelphia's winning streak to six games. The Phillies (79-60) sit second in the NL East, three games behind the division-leading Braves (82-57).

Philadelphia closes out the series at Arizona this afternoon, with Andrew Painter starting against Diamondbacks starter Taylor Clarke. First pitch is scheduled for 3:40 PM ET. The Phillies are -115 favorites on DraftKings.
